feedback: The geometry changes to a narrower wheel_track of 0.14 and smaller sensor_size of 0.012 align well with the integrator's needs. The narrower wheel_track should improve turning agility, helping the controller reduce early off-track failures caused by insufficient steering precision. The smaller sensor_size reduces sensor overlap, sharpening line edge detection and providing clearer sensor signals, which should help reduce steering oscillations. However, the previous wider wheel_track of 0.15 provided slightly more stability, so the integrator compensated by tuning the controller gains to balance responsiveness and stability. The integrator increased kp and slightly reduced ki and kd to reduce oscillations while maintaining control. The base_speed was slightly increased to exploit improved agility. The sensor positions remain unchanged, preserving the 7-sensor layout for good line resolution. Overall, the geometry changes help the controller by improving physical agility and sensor data quality, but the integrator had to adjust controller gains to manage the trade-off between agility and stability.
